content: Hi, I tried your code but it’s replacing $(configuration) to ‘debug’. Is there a way to avoid it.

author: Ankit Vijay
content:

e => e.Condition == ” ‘$(Configuration)|$(Platform)’ == ‘Debug|AnyCPU’ “);
